name: 1611 Prairie Avenue — Pre-1911 paired frame house (district draft; refined by T-1867)

function.note: The 1911 sheet draws a 1911 loft at 1607-1611, not a 1904 building. The T-1840 census (frontage-20-024, backcast_1886) stands the lot-6 frame pair for 1904 on the supplied expert guidance (named record pa-1611-1904-correction) because Robinson 1886 plate 10 prints 1611 against the south half of it. There is no 1904 directory listing at the address; residence is inferred from the register's 'pre-1911 paired frame house'.

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2335, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1867 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the Robinson 1886 plate 10 reading (r1886-1611-f: the south half of the lot-6 frame pair in the plate's pixels, carried by its T-1250 fit) (r1886-1611-f), the T-1840 census (r1886-1611-f) and the T-1837 register row frontage-20-024 (Pre-1911 paired frame house); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-16-18-east-2335).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: Robinson 1886 draws the pair and the T-1840 census carries it to 1904 on the expert guidance. The 1911 sheet draws the loft in its place, so the pair was gone by then; when 1611 was built and when it went are T-1867's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 1611 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_1607 (data/street_grid/1904.json), east side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 16th to 18th Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 20).
position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 13.750, v 2.750 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the plate: the plate's fit is 4.54 m RMS, the weakest of the four T-1250 fits (a photographed atlas page, rotated and curved toward the binding), plus about a pixel (0.35 m) of reading. Rotation 179.605 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

derivation.reason: The four derivation methods re-derive from the 1835 files; this position is re-derived from the traced sheet and the 1904 parcel by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py --check instead.

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: RECONSTRUCTED: Robinson's atlas prints no storey count, and the 1911 sheet, which would, draws the four-storey loft that replaced the pair. Two storeys is the draft's reading of the register's 'modest frame facade, timber cornice, sash windows and bounded roof/stoop'; T-1867 reads the pair's height.

construction.note: Robinson 1886 colours the pair yellow, the plate's frame (its brick buildings are pink, as the pair on lot 7 next south is); the register's 'pre-1911 paired frame house' agrees.

parts.from: r1886-1611-f p1 (main, frame), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 97% of its fill

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): r1886-1611-f p1 (main, frame), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 97% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: The register's 'pre-1911 paired frame house' (1611, the second member of the lot-6 pair): two frame storeys under a simple gable with one stack, the pair's doors at its outer ends so the two read as two houses with 1609 across the party wall. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 2948420885 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-prairie-16-18-east-2335.
